2609.00969.title: The zbMATH Open Knowledge Graph: Tracing Centuries of Mathematical Research
2609.00969.paper_summary: We present the zbMATH Open Knowledge Graph, a large-scale RDF knowledge graph (KG) covering more than 250 years of mathematical scholarship. Unlike existing scholarly knowledge graphs that primarily capture bibliographic metadata and citation structures, the zbMATH Open KG integrates expert-curated semantic content, including reviews, keywords, subject classifications, software references, and disambiguated authorship. This combination of domain-specific representation of mathematical knowledge and extensive temporal coverage supports analyses that require fine-grained exploration of mathematical concepts, research fields, and scholarly relationships over time. The resulting graph comprises 34 million entities and 168 million RDF triples represented using established Semantic Web vocabularies, supporting interoperability and FAIR data principles. We further demonstrate its capabilities through query-driven historically grounded scholarly exploration use cases, illustrating how the knowledge graph can surface relationships and patterns that may be difficult to identify from bibliographic and citation information alone. The zbMATH Open KG provides an open semantic infrastructure for studying the development of mathematical knowledge and tracing scholarly connections across centuries of scholarship.
2609.00969.paper_summary_zh: 我們呈現 zbMATH 開放知識圖譜，這是一個涵蓋超過 250 年數學學術的規模龐大的 RDF 知識圖譜 (KG)。與主要捕捉書目元數據和引用結構的現有學術知識圖譜不同，zbMATH 開放 KG 整合了專家策劃的語義內容，包括評論、關鍵詞、主題分類、軟體參考和消歧義的作者身份。這種數學知識的領域特定表示與廣泛的時間覆蓋相結合，支持需要對數學概念、研究領域和學術關係進行細緻探索的分析。最終的圖譜包含 3400 萬個實體和 1.68 億個 RDF 三元組，使用已建立的語義網詞彙表示，支持互操作性和 FAIR 數據原則。我們進一步通過查詢驅動的歷史基礎學術探索用例展示其能力，說明知識圖譜如何揭示可能僅從書目和引用信息中難以識別的關係和模式。zbMATH 開放 KG 提供了一個開放的語義基礎設施，用於研究數學知識的發展和追溯跨越幾個世紀的學術連結。
